verdict.rationale: Oneleet has an "API and MCP" docs section describing scoped service keys for "AI agent automation, MCP servers, and scripts to interact with your Oneleet workspace," with full or limited scope grants. That points to first-party programmatic access, but the evidence never shows an actual API reference, and probes found no OpenAPI spec. The MCP server is a separate story and earns no credit here. Missing for 10: a documented REST/GraphQL endpoint reference, a published OpenAPI/Swagger spec (all probe paths 404), evidence of which operations are exposed, and independent or hands-on corroboration of API use.
